title: Origin preservation under allocation
statement: Let $ho$ be either direction, and let $\\gamma$ be a guide tape whose origin mark occurs exactly at coordinate $0$. For every natural number $j$ and every integer coordinate $z$, the $j$-cell filled tape carries the origin mark at $z$ if and only if $z=0$.
hypotheses_covered: The direction is Boolean, selecting rightward or leftward
The guide tape carries the origin mark exactly at coordinate $0$
replaced:
If a guide tape carries the origin mark exactly at cell $0$, then for every $j$ and
either direction, its $j$-cell filled version also carries the origin mark exactly at
cell $0$.
